title: Compaction timing reads message tokens, not total context
why: Your idea, Oct 27 16:49 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2AdH3Lyos1aUGY9YCpUrDM4, with a screenshot of a 500k context: messages 379k, 76%, and about 85k fixed overhead from system, tools, prompt, memory and skills that compaction cannot shrink): the compact hooks and auto-compact timing could be smarter if they measured messages only.
note: Unknown today: whether a hook's input exposes the context breakdown; the transcript file can at least be counted. Step 1, a cloud measuring lane: list what PreCompact, Stop and statusline inputs carry about tokens on the current Claude Code, and count message tokens from the transcript; record the answer in docs/decisions. Step 2, only if a number is readable: base the hand-off and compact thresholds on messages as a share of the room left after the fixed overhead, not on total context; red first on a session whose overhead alone trips today's threshold. No earlier step covers it (closed c25 and o15 shaped the hand-off, not its timing). Step 1 merged in batch #737 (main b09aece, Oct 28 01:19 CDT), PR #731 (record hook-inputs-carry-token-counts). PreCompact and Stop inputs carry no token counts; statusLine (interactive only) carries context_window.current_usage, the transcript's last usage; nothing splits overhead (36.6k to 42.1k here) from messages. Deferred (shiv, Oct 28): step 2's token source. Asked: waiting page item 30. Port: no; hooks install from claude-settings. Placed ahead of c58 (triage, Oct 27): useful, not urgent.
